captureGuidance: Lift lip gently to expose maxillary premolars and canine.
Capture lateral and frontal views if the dog allows.
Note halitosis in owner symptoms when present.

findingFields.label: Tartar grade (estimate)
findingFields.description: Visual tartar index 0–3 from oral photo

findingFields.label: Gingival inflammation
findingFields.description: Redness or swelling at gum line

differentialConsiderations: Oral mass ( cannot confirm without exam )
suggestedDiagnostics: Complete oral exam under sedation if dental procedure planned
Cytology or biopsy of mass lesions
urgentIndicators: inability to eat with acute onset
